entities.summary: Sulochana (b. 1955-03-12, Jhochhen) was a social reformer or activist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Jhochhen and Nepal. Known in the fields of nepal, activists & reformers, asia.
